articles.title: EU urges to challenge Apple's grip on iPhone browsers
articles.description: In a new letter to regulators, businesses and advocacy groups say that even slightly loosened in the European Union, Apple's WebKit requirements still make it effectively impractical to sell subscriptions outside the App Store. Groups urge EU to enforce Apple's iPhone browser rules Businesses and civil society organizations are urging the European Commission to open formal proceedings against Apple over iPhone browser competition. They say Apple's restrictions still keep browser makers from moving existing EU users off WebKit. The letter is available to read on Open Web Advocacy's site. The authors say the signatories collectively represent an estimated 45,000-55,000 EU-established businesses and organizations. Continue Reading on AppleInsider | Discuss on our Forums
